objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-impair-defenses-disable-auto-logger-session
objects.description: The following analytic detects the disabling of an AutoLogger session or one of its providers, by identifying changes to the Registry values "Start" and "Enabled" part of the "\WMI\Autologger\" key path. It leverages data from the Endpoint.Registry datamodel to monitor specific registry paths and values.
